purpose: Review fixtures only; no Journey admission uses these coordinates

points.label: Offa town reference point
points.selectionBasis: Geoapify Offa locality result, checked against unsimplified GRID3 polygon with ST_Contains; not a specific building

points.label: National Hospital Abuja
points.selectionBasis: Geoapify named-facility result; Federal Ministry of Health independently lists the hospital in Abuja FCT; checked with ST_Contains

points.label: Federal Teaching Hospital Gombe
points.selectionBasis: Geoapify named-facility result; hospital's own contact page identifies Gombe city; checked with ST_Contains

points.label: Delta State University, Abraka
points.selectionBasis: Geoapify named-campus result; university's own About page confirms its Abraka campus; checked with ST_Contains

points.label: Oyun locality reference point outside Offa
points.selectionBasis: Geoapify Oyun locality result, checked with ST_Contains in Oyun and ST_Covers=false in Offa

points.label: Exact Offa/Oyun shared border vertex
points.selectionBasis: ST_PointN at half the vertex count of the longest LineString in ST_Intersection(ST_Boundary(Offa), ST_Boundary(Oyun)); both polygons ST_Covers=true and ST_Contains=false
